prompt: Grignard with a ketone: cyclohexanone + ethylmagnesium bromide (EtMgBr); then H3O+ workup. Draw the alcohol product.
explanation: Grignard adds ethyl to the carbonyl C of the ketone, giving an alkoxide. Acidic workup protonates it to a 3° alcohol. The quaternary C bears the ring + original substituent + new ethyl + OH.
